title: 1812 Prairie's south projection gets its balcony
items: George H. Wheeler's house at 1812 Prairie now has the iron balcony that Albert Levy's photograph shows on the flat top of its south projection, where it had a bare tin deck.

The rail's height and baluster spacing are read off the photograph through its solved camera; the solid stone panel in the middle of the photographed rail is not built yet, and is listed as open on the house's match record.
